## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix(timers): …`, `docs: …`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (README, docstrings, `docs/`, protocol notes)
- [ ] No credentials, installation codes, real addresses or decompiled app sources
- [ ] Destructive commands were only exercised against the fake cloud / box of the tests
